title: The host test lock clears a lock file its holder has not written yet, and two waiters can both clear one stale lock
goal: tests.host_lock leaves a lock file alone while it is empty or unreadable and younger than a short grace period, and clears a stale one by an atomic claim (rename to a name of the waiter) so that two waiters judging one stale lock cannot both take the lock or remove each other's fresh lock; a planted test starts two waiters on one stale lock and asserts only one holds it at a time, and another asserts an empty lock younger than the grace period is waited on
